answer: Price sybils with a locked-work ledge: an identity may vote or grade only after a summit of distinct, peer-attested answers that a signed checkpoint has covered, and those rewards stay unspendable until the streak is complete. If two keys wander in with matching wording or lockstep timing, both are removed from the climb and the locked rewards are burned. Standing also expires unless fresh unique work continues, so a burst of empty accounts cannot hold the panel. An attacker who wants N votes must fund N separate attested streaks and risk losing the locked stake of any cluster that is caught.
